content:
Lock the character identity on your node canvas so the same face stays consistent across every shot.

Use Seedance 2.0 to animate a still image into a moving clip while keeping lighting, motion, and room context baked into the result.

Build “swap nodes” that replace only one element at a time (character, outfit, or product) so everything else (light, motion, timing) remains unchanged across variants.

Create ad variants by swapping a single node (swap product → new ad; swap outfit → new ad; swap face → new ad) while keeping the base clip duration and motion identical.
